workspace.recordCount: {count, plural, =0 {No records} one {# record} other {# records}}
workspace.noMatchesBody: Clear one or more filters to widen the list.
workspace.emptyBody: Records appear here as soon as they are created.

request.title: Request support
request.description: Tell us what you need help with. The Programme Head reads every request and matches you with an advisor, usually within two working days.
request.typeTitle: What do you need help with?
request.typeHint: Pick the closest one; the advisor can refer you on if needed.

type.academicHint: A subject you are struggling with, your study plan, credits, FLM/FAP/LMS resources.
type.wellbeingHint: Stress, accommodation, family, everyday money advice, certificates and paperwork.

request.moneyNote: Borrowing money or financial support is handled by the Student Welfare Officer. Ask here and your advisor will refer you.
request.noCategories: No categories are open for this kind of help yet. Contact the faculty office.
request.subject: Subject (optional)
request.subjectHint: Choosing the subject helps match you with an advisor who teaches it.
request.reasonTitle: Tell your advisor what is going on
request.reasonHint: In your own words. Only the matched advisor and the Programme Head can read this.
request.reasonPlaceholder: For example: I failed the first progress test and I do not understand the topic. I would like help to plan how to catch up.
request.reasonItemsTitle: Add context to what you share
request.reasonItemsHint: Your advisor will see what the university has on record for each item below, but not the story behind it. Explain in your own words. This is optional.
request.reasonItemPlaceholder: For example: what the record does not show, or what has changed recently.
request.reasonTooLong: Your request is too long. Shorten it to send.
request.shareTitle: Choose which records your advisor can see
request.shareBody: Ticked items are shared for {purpose} only. They come from your university records and cannot be edited here; you can explain them in your own words in the next step. If a value looks wrong, you can ask for a correction under Corrections. You can withdraw them at any time under Consent.
request.shareFootnote: Nothing is shared unless you tick it. Every time someone reads it, it appears in your access history.
request.nothingToShare: This kind of request does not use any of your data.
request.summaryShared: Your advisor will see {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}:
request.summaryNothingShared: You are not sharing any data with this request.
request.sentBody: You will get an email and a notification with your advisor's contact details as soon as you are matched.
request.seeRequests: See the requests you have already sent →
request.next1Body: The Programme Head picks the advisor best placed to help.
request.next2Body: By email and in AdviseCare. You arrange how and when to meet.
request.next3Body: Every step is recorded here, and you can see who read your data.
request.lockedType: Choose the kind of help in step 1 first.
request.lockedCategory: Choose a category in step 2 first.
request.draftAutosave: Saved on this device as you type.
request.draftRestored: We restored what you were writing last time.
request.confirmIntro: Read it through once more before you send.
request.confirmSharedNone: No data is shared with this request.
request.confirmWarningTitle: You cannot edit or cancel a request after sending it
request.confirmWarningBody: If you spot a mistake later, send a new request or tell your advisor once you are matched. You can stop sharing data at any time under Consent.

outreach.title: Open a case for a student
outreach.description: Reach out to a student who has not asked for help. They are notified and can see your contact details.
outreach.studentHint: Search by full name or student code.
outreach.refineSearch: Showing the first 20 matches. Refine your search to narrow them down.
outreach.lockedStudent: Pick a student in step 1 first.
outreach.lockedCategory: Pick a category in step 2 first.
outreach.categoryHint: Only categories for your type of advising are listed.
outreach.noCategories: No active support categories are available for your role.
outreach.subject: Subject (optional)
outreach.reasonHint: The student reads this, so describe your concern in plain, supportive words.
outreach.reasonPlaceholder: What have you noticed, and how would you like to help?
outreach.consentNoticeBody: The case starts assigned to you. You can only see the student's data after they consent to it.
outreach.summary: A case will be opened for {name} and assigned to you.
outreach.sentBody: {name} has been notified. The case is now in your caseload.

case.notFoundTitle: This request could not be found
case.notFoundBody: It may belong to another account, or the link is wrong.
case.meetHint: Contact your advisor to agree how and when to meet (online or in person).
case.waitingMatch: Matching usually takes up to two working days. You will get an email with your advisor's contact as soon as it happens.
case.waitingFor: {count, plural, =0 {Sent today} one {Waiting # day so far} other {Waiting # days so far}}

matching.title: Matching queue
matching.description: Support requests waiting for an advisor. Pick a request, check the suggested advisors and assign it.
matching.finding: {count, plural, one {# request is} other {# requests are}} waiting for an advisor; the oldest has waited {days, plural, =0 {less than a day} one {# day} other {# days}}.
matching.waitedDays: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} waiting
matching.emptyBody: New requests appear here as soon as a student sends one.
matching.suggestionsHint: Ordered by: already advising this student, subject specialist, same faculty, fewest open cases.
matching.noSuggestionsTitle: No active advisor of this type
matching.noSuggestionsBody: Ask the administrator to activate an advisor account for this kind of help.
matching.notePlaceholder: For example: matched with the PRF192 specialist.
matching.confirmBody: {student} and the advisor are notified, and the student receives the advisor's contact details.
matching.assignedBody: Both have been notified. The case is now in the advisor's list.
matching.pick: Choose a request from the queue.
matching.findingOverdue: {count, plural, one {# is} other {# are}} overdue (waiting 2+ days).
matching.noteHint: The student sees this reason in their case history.

advisorCase.notFoundTitle: This case could not be found
advisorCase.notFoundBody: It may not be assigned to you, or the link is wrong.
advisorCase.notesPrivate: Visible to staff on this case, never to the student
advisorCase.noNotes: No notes yet. Write down what you discussed after each meeting.
advisorCase.notePlaceholder: What was discussed, and the actions you agreed (who does what, by when).
advisorCase.draftHint: Saved as a draft you can still edit. Finalize it to sign it; then it can no longer change.
advisorCase.finalizeBody: A finalized note is signed with your name and can never be edited or deleted.
advisorCase.moveStageHint: Record what happened. The reason is kept in the stage history and the student sees the new stage.
advisorCase.closeConfirmBody: The student is notified. You can reopen it later with a reason.
advisorCase.reopenHint: Reopening puts the case back to 'Assigned' with you as advisor.
advisorCase.referHint: Another advisor, or the Student Welfare Officer for money matters. The case waits until they accept or return it.
advisorCase.receiverHint: Type part of a name or email: another advisor or a Student Welfare Officer.
advisorCase.changeAdvisorHint: The Programme Head decides. Until then the case stays with you.
advisorCase.changeRequested: Change request sent to the Programme Head.
advisorCase.proposedAdvisorHint: Type part of the advisor's name or email. The Programme Head approves the change.
advisorCase.stageConfirmBody: The student sees the new stage and what you wrote in the history. History entries cannot be edited.
advisorCase.reopenConfirmBody: The case returns to your caseload and the student is notified with your reason.
advisorCase.priorityConfirmBody: The case moves in the caseload and matching queue order.
advisorCase.referConfirmBody: The receiver is notified. The case cannot change stage until they accept or return it.
advisorCase.changeConfirmBody: The Programme Head decides. The student and both advisors are notified of the decision.

myRequests.title: My support requests
myRequests.description: Every request you have sent, where it stands and who is looking after it.
myRequests.emptyTitle: You have not asked for support yet
myRequests.emptyBody: Tell us what you need help with and the Programme Head will match you with an advisor.
myRequests.noneOpen: Nothing in progress. Your closed requests are below.
myRequests.showClosed: Show {count, plural, one {# closed request} other {# closed requests}}
myRequests.waitingToday: Sent today · waiting for a match
myRequests.waitingDays: Waiting for a match · sent {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago

caseMessages.title: Messages
caseMessages.studentIntro: Write to your advisor and read their replies. Your advisor's private case notes are not shown here.
caseMessages.staffIntro: The thread between the student and the case's advisor. Messages are recorded for good and cannot be edited or deleted.
caseMessages.emptyStudentHint: You can ask a question or reply to your advisor here.
caseMessages.emptyStaffHint: Use this space for short next steps, meeting arrangements or questions for the student.
caseMessages.placeholderStudent: For example: Thank you. Thursday at 2 pm works for me.
caseMessages.placeholderAdvisor: For example: I have read your request. Can we meet on Thursday at 2 pm in room 203, or online?
caseMessages.limitHint: Up to 1,000 characters. A message cannot be changed once it is sent.
caseMessages.sentStudent: Sent. Your advisor has been notified.
caseMessages.sentAdvisor: Sent. The student has been notified.
caseMessages.closedHint: This case is closed, so no new messages can be written.
caseMessages.waitingHint: You can write here once an advisor has been assigned to your case.
caseMessages.readOnlyHint: Only the student and the case's current advisor can write here.
caseMessages.attachHint: Up to {count} files, 10 MB each: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text, CSV or images.
caseMessages.fileTypeError: {name} cannot be attached. Use PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text, CSV or an image.
caseMessages.fileCountError: A message can carry at most {count} files.

caseShared.introStudent: The data you chose to share with this request and your note about each one. You can withdraw a consent in Consent at any time.
caseShared.introAdvisor: The student's data you may read for this case, with the student's note about each item they shared. Every value shown is written to the access log.
caseShared.introStaff: The data the student chose to share with this request and their note about each one. Only the case's advisor sees the values here.
caseShared.loadError: Could not load the student's data.
caseShared.noValuesHint: The student has not shared any data under this case's purpose yet. You can send a consent request if more data is needed.
caseShared.noneStudent: You did not share any data with this request.
caseShared.noneStaff: The student did not share any data with this request.
